steps.note: The colostrum is curdled; how, rennet or heat, the sources do not say.
The curd is set into a round disk 2 to 3 cm thick.
The disk is baked, grilled or flambeed until browned or charred.

processing.text: Traditionally it was then dried nearly rock hard and kept for years, and warmed over a fire before eating.

sources.text: The steps are those of leipäjuusto, the best known colostrum cheese of this kind, from these articles, which give no temperatures or times and mark the curdling as lacking a citation.
